resources.string: What happened, or what would you like?
The first picture is Hex as it was when you opened this. A dictation shown on Home is left out of it.

When you tap Send, Hex sends your message, the pictures above, your email, Hex’s version and the language and speech model it dictates with, your phone’s model, Android version and language, the screen you opened this from, and a random install ID that keeps your reports together, to Anomaly’s feedback inbox (Bellhop). Nothing you dictate or type elsewhere is sent.

When you tap Send, Hex sends your message, the pictures above, Hex’s version and the language and speech model it dictates with, your phone’s model, Android version and language, and the screen you opened this from to Anomaly’s feedback inbox (Bellhop). Without an email it’s anonymous: no install ID is sent, and it can’t be answered. Nothing you dictate or type elsewhere is sent.
